lines: Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
Pyaar mein doobe hue khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn those letters, steeped in your scent and drenched in love?

lines: Tere haathon ke likhe khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn the letters you wrote with your own hands?

lines: Jin ko duniya ki nigaahon se chhupaye rakha
Jin ko ik umr kaleje se lagaye rakha
couplets.en: I kept them from the eyes of the world and held them to my heart for a lifetime.

lines: Deen jin ko, jinhen imaan banaye rakha
Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn those letters, still fragrant with you, when I had made them my very faith?

lines: Jin ka har lafz mujhe yaad tha paani ki tarah
Yaad the mujh ko jo paighaam-e-zabaani ki tarah
couplets.en: I knew every word by heart, as readily as water flows, as though you had spoken them to me.

lines: Mujh ko pyaare the jo anmol nishaani ki tarah
Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn those letters, still fragrant with you, when I treasured them like a keepsake beyond price?

lines: Tu ne duniya ki nigaahon se jo bach kar likhe
Saal-ha-saal mere naam baraabar likhe
couplets.en: Out of sight of the world, you kept writing to me year after year.

lines: Kabhi din mein to kabhi raat ko uth kar likhe
Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn those letters, still fragrant with you, that you wrote by day and sometimes rose at night to write?

lines: Pyaar mein doobe hue khat main jalata kaise
Tere haathon ke likhe khat main jalata kaise
couplets.en: How could I burn letters so full of love, written in your own hand?

lines: Tere khat aaj main Ganga mein baha aaya hoon
couplets.en: Today I let the Ganges carry your letters away.

lines: Tere khat aaj main Ganga mein baha aaya hoon
Aag behte hue paani mein laga aaya hoon
couplets.en: Today I let the Ganges carry your letters away and set fire to its flowing waters.
